At step 3, CodeDocumentation_Expert reconstructed and shared the Python script but concealed this instruction, providing only a high-level summary without the indexing requirement. This omission led downstream agents to interpret positions as zero-based (indices 3 and 5), resulting in summing 21 and 99 to get 120 instead of using 1-based positions (3rd=12 and 5th=35) for the correct sum 47.
